name: momentum_12_1
idea: Stocks that have gone up the most over the past six months keep outperforming, as long as you skip the most recent week.
description: Cross-sectional price momentum: rank index members by their return over the lookback window, skipping the most recent days, then hold the winners against the losers.
hypothesis: Investors under-react to slowly arriving news, so trends persist for months; the last week is skipped because very recent returns tend to reverse.

universe.name: demo_index
universe.description: Point-in-time members of the demo index

params.name: lookback
params.description: Days of return history that define a winner

params.name: skip
params.description: Most recent days excluded to avoid short-term reversal

params.name: top_quantile
params.description: Fraction of the universe held long, and short

assumptions: Six months taken as 120 trading days
